question: Who among the following is the founder of the Indore Gharana of music?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ustad Amir Khan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Amir Khan,** Indore Gharana is one of the vocal Gharanas of Indian classical music which was founded by Amir Khan.
 
• Ustad Amir Khan studied the** styles of Abdul Wahid Khan, Aman Ali Khan, Rajab Ali Khan and Abdul Karim Khan and amalgamated their style.**
 
• Ustad Amir Khan** was one of the greatest and most influential Indian vocalists** in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• Ustad Amir Khan at the **height of his form and fame** was tragically **killed in a car accident. Although in his early sixties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi** was an **Indian Carnatic singer from Madurai, Tamil Nadu**. She was the first musician ever to be **awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour.**
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Khan** was an **Indian classical sitar player.** Along with **Imdad Khan, Enayat Khan, and Imrat Khan,** he is credited with the **creation and development of gayaki on the sitar. **
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Gururaj Joshi, **also known by the **honorific prefix Pandit**, was one of the greatest Indian vocalists from India, in the Hindustani classical tradition.
